description:
Cast Channel the Suns by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve the copy of Channel the Suns, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
